name: held-out example
wording: withheld from builders by omission alone, kept with the design, used only in code review, its reviewer taking it directly, so a user story shipped with no code review has none; a failure reaches builders as its concept, never its case; once exposed it becomes visible and is replaced cold
reason: The design held that a story shipped without code review has no held-out examples, and the restated concept had dropped it.
